The clinical presentation — a 2-month history of progressive, nontraumatic, nocturnal left knee pain and swelling in an otherwise healthy patient — points to an intraosseous process rather than inflammatory arthritis or infection. - MRI findings (soft-tissue extension, fluid-fluid levels, enhancement pattern) — pending but not yet reported  
- Absence of reported calcifications (would weigh against chondroblastoma)

[DIAGNOSIS]  
Giant cell tumor of bone
